title_suffix: continuous Goal convergence and durable blocker recovery
summary: OSpec 1.8.9 keeps Goals moving while evidence is converging without turning retries into an infinite loop. Task, final, and document review continue past their former fixed thresholds only for a new structured finding-ID set; repeated or cycling findings stop. Repair workers receive immutable review context, durable external blockers are not redispatched, independent ready work runs first, and orphaned IN_PROGRESS tasks recover automatically after their absolute runtime deadline.
new: Added continueWhileProgressing, enabled by default and configurable with --continue-while-progressing true|false.
Added immutable task-review repair context with review and findings paths, hashes, stable IDs, evidence, requirements, and bounded repair scope.
Added durable retryable classification for blocker records and deadline-based recovery assessments for orphaned IN_PROGRESS tasks.
improved: Dispatches conflict-safe independent ready tasks before waiting review, repair, or technical retry work.
Treats the existing two-round repair settings as convergence thresholds in continuous mode while retaining strict compatibility mode.
Lets document review continue without the fixed round and stage-time gates while structured findings converge, preserving all explicit Loop and no-progress guards.
Resets periodic comprehension debt in continuous mode instead of pausing an otherwise progressing Goal.
fixed: Fixed repair dispatches omitting the prior task-review findings and artifact provenance.
Fixed durable device blockers being redispatched without any external state change.
Fixed a Goal stopping at the repair lifetime ceiling even when a new remaining finding proved convergence.
Fixed old document review round and cumulative stage-time limits stopping progressing Goals.
Fixed tasks remaining permanently IN_PROGRESS after their Loop pending action was lost.
Fixed same or cycling finding-ID sets, including reworded descriptions, being misclassified as progress.
docs: Documented continuous convergence, strict compatibility mode, blocker classification, orphan recovery, faster ready-work scheduling, and the confirmed multi-project incidents.
